lines.speaker: A
lines.english: How long have you been studying Chinese?

lines.speaker: B
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xué le liǎng nián le.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: A little difficult. Writing characters is the hardest.

lines.speaker: B
lines.pinyin: 我上课，也自己复习。每天听录音。
lines.hanzi: 我上课，也自己复习。每天听录音。
lines.english: I take classes and also review on my own. I listen to recordings every day.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Can you speak a lot of Chinese?

lines.speaker: B
lines.pinyin: 会说一些。但听不太懂快的语速。
lines.hanzi: 会说一些。但听不太懂快的语速。
lines.english: I can speak some. But I can't understand fast speech well.
